title: Floating bubble in a gradient field
slide_intent: Use travel, scale and focus to give a simple element a sense of depth.
strategic_value: A drifting bubble can animate O2 backgrounds without requiring another brand symbol.
demonstration: A single bubble drifts through a blue gradient, changing position, apparent size and softness as its highlights shift.
practical_value: Judge the bubble against its field throughout the movement so it stays perceptible without dominating the frame.

content_islands.name: Atmospheric field
content_islands.spec: Fill the frame with a dark-blue upper region that lightens toward the bottom.

content_islands.name: Drifting bubble
content_islands.spec: Move one translucent bubble through the open field while varying its softness and apparent size.

reference_purposes.Expression: The clip demonstrates the bubble’s floating, softly shaded behavior.
reference_purposes.Application: It places the bubble over a gradient background as a self-contained animated field.
